About this Event

Gaby Maldonado is a yoga and wellness facilitator who combines her background in health psychology with ancient yogic teachings to bring awareness, healing, and mindfulness to students around the globe. As a former athlete and a traumatic brain injury survivor, Gaby has a unique ability to meet individuals where they currently are and create a yoga practice specific to them. Originally from Mt. Hood, Oregon, she has practiced yoga since childhood and taught professionally for the past 12 years. She continues to travel the world to share her offerings with countless communities and cultures, both in English and Spanish. Gaby is most known for her soulful yin yoga, steady hatha practice, and joyful spirit.
